path.id: Understand the journey before choosing it.
Planning a journey can mean checking different sources for routes, fares and timings. Walking distances, transfers still be unclear, making it difficult to choose a suitable option.
Route cards place time and fare together; expanded steps explain how to complete the journey. The active ticket keeps boarding information close at hand.
One pass for all your needs
